raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Senior Associate Consultant – Tech
📌 The Automation Office (TAO) | 📆 Apr 2023 – Present | 📍 Bangalore, India
Project: Accounting & Finance Manual Bot [LLM-RAG]
Developed and implemented an LLM-RAG bot to analyze and determine appropriate accounting treatments for various sales transactions.
Covered areas such as hardware sales, warranties, Care Packs services, contra revenue, and special negotiated discounts.
Enhanced accuracy and compliance in financial reporting through advanced data analysis and model refinement.
Integrated embedding methods to enhance retrieval of relevant information within the LLM RAG application.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams like cybersecurity for data protection and DevOps for deployment pipelines.
Project: Automation Toner Supplies NPI Modeling
Designed and automated business processes to reduce processing time per item and increase efficiency.
Eliminated human errors and optimized workflow execution.
Key Achievements:
✔ Reduced processing time by 40% through automation.

Python Developer
📌 Optimal Virtual Employee | 📆 Nov 2021 – Apr 2023 | 📍 Bangalore, India
Project: pAIges
Developed intelligent document processing solutions for financial documents (Invoices, Credit Notes, Purchase Orders).
Extracted key fields from unstructured financial documents and pushed data to RPA systems for touchless payments.
Designed backend APIs, implemented business logic, and built workflow automation.
Integrated Azure cloud services (Logic Apps, Webhooks, Service Bus, Event Hub) for real-time data processing.
Tech Stack:
Programming Languages: Python, SQL, NoSQL
ML Techniques: Image Processing, Feature Engineering, Text Extraction, Classification
Cloud Services: Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure Service Bus
APIs & Frameworks: Flask, FastAPI, Kelvin
Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
Data Analyst
📌 Relentless Sports Retail Pvt Ltd | 📆 Jan 2020 – Nov 2021 | 📍 Bangalore, India
Generated online sales reports, analyzed customer purchase trends, and measured business performance.
Managed inventory replenishment systems ensuring adequate stock availability.
Conducted quantitative research & analysis on inventory data to provide actionable insights.
Developed a price optimization strategy to improve sales growth & profitability.
Assisted in merchandising, promotions, digital marketing investments, and site metrics for e-commerce optimization.
📜 Diploma in Data Science | Naresh Technologies | July 2018 – September 2018
